title: WTO - WTO maps
content:
Key information about the WTO and world trade is displayed in the   maps listed below. This includes information on membership of the WTO and various trade agreements, disputes between WTO members, and world trade   flows.
Members and observers of the WTO
Membership of WTO plurilateral agreements
Information Technology Agreement
Membership of negotiating groups in the Doha negotiations
Membership of Regional Trade Agreements
Trade statistics and basic tariff data
A wide range of statistical indicators are available
(e.g. trade per capita, exports, average tariff)
Members accepting amendment of the TRIPS
Members accepting the Protocol of Amendment to insert the WTO Trade Facilitation Agreement into Annex 1A of the WTO Agreement
